Makes selected tiles available on the local network: for display, e.g.
an ESP32 display or a browser on your phone, and — only when explicitly
allowed — for remote control. Nothing is shared until a “Read” box below
is ticked. The connection is unencrypted and intended for a trusted home
or lab network only — never make the port reachable from the internet
(no port forwarding, no UPnP).

Remote control: over the network, setpoints can be set and outputs
switched (e.g. by an AI assistant through the MCP server). It applies only
to devices with “Control” ticked, never during a test run or after a safety
trip, and always requires the token — from other devices additionally only
while the master switch is on. “ALL OFF” works at any time.

Mindestabstand zwischen zwei Sollwert-Up:
Minimum interval between two setpoint updates (send to send). The instruments are not real
signal generators -- the signal is approximated as a series of single commands over the
serial interface; if the instrument acknowledges more slowly, the next value follows right
after the acknowledgement. “Auto”: as fast as acknowledged, at least 100 ms.
The actual intervals are listed in the report.
